 26WD99864, Maya Software Developer 
 
 Position Overview 
 Autodesk Maya is one of the leading software packages used for content creation by some of the biggest names in VFX, TV, and Games. On the Autodesk Consulting Media and Entertainment Team, we have an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software developer and subject matter expert to join our growing team, directly supporting our customers in the amazing work they do. As a key member of our team, you will be collaborating directly with our global customers as they develop their tools and workflows around Maya, providing advice and guidance from both a technical and a production perspective.  You will be responsible for advising them, diagnosing issues, finding solutions, and developing fixes and enhancements in the product that help them to be successful.
 
 Responsibilities 
 Collaborate with top studios using Maya to understand their existing pipelines and requirements, to build solutions, improve efficiency or functionality of those pipelines

 Work with other developers, user experience designers, QAs, and product owners to identify, troubleshoot, design, and develop product fixes and enhancements

 Develop high quality code, write functional tests, and collaborate on technical designs

 Be a member of a fun, collaborative, high-performing team and contribute directly to the success of the Autodesk Consulting M&E Team and our customers

 Occasional travel to customer sites and Autodesk offices may be required

 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 5+ years software engineering and/or production experience, ideally developing tools and workflows using the Maya C++ or Python APIs utilizing computer graphics algorithms and techniques

 Demonstrated knowledge of Game and/or Film Production Pipelines

 Experience and strong coding proficiency with C++ and Python. 

 Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills, ability to work well in a cross-functional, high-performing team, and communicate highly technical information to customers

 Strong technical troubleshooting skills

 Exceptional organizational skills. Comfortable working independently to tackle challenges in a remote working environment.

 Experience with AI/ML frameworks as well as working with Codex or other similar tools to aid in coding.

 Fluent in spoken and written English.

 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience using or developing within other key Autodesk products.  For example: Arnold, 3dsMax, MotionBuilder, Flow Production Tracking, Flow Capture, RV, etc

 Familiarity with C# or game engines (Unreal or Unity)

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 26WD99864, Développeur de logiciels Maya 
 
 Aperçu du Poste 
 Autodesk Maya est l’un des principaux logiciels utilisés pour la création de contenu par certains des plus grands noms des effets spéciaux, de la télévision et des jeux vidéo. Au sein de l’équipe Autodesk Consulting Media and Entertainment, nous proposons une opportunité passionnante à un développeur logiciel d’exception et expert en la matière, qui rejoindra notre équipe en pleine expansion afin d’accompagner directement nos clients dans le travail extraordinaire qu’ils réalisent. En tant que membre clé de notre équipe, vous collaborerez directement avec nos clients internationaux dans le cadre du développement de leurs outils et de leurs workflows autour de Maya, en leur apportant conseils et accompagnement tant d’un point de vue technique que de production. Vous aurez la responsabilité de les conseiller, de diagnostiquer les problèmes, de trouver des solutions, ainsi que de développer des correctifs et des améliorations du produit qui les aideront à réussir.
 
 Responsabilités 
 Collaborer avec les meilleurs studios utilisant Maya pour comprendre leurs pipelines existants et leurs besoins, afin de mettre au point des solutions, d’améliorer l’efficacité ou les fonctionnalités de ces pipelines

 Travailler avec d’autres développeurs, concepteurs d’expérience utilisateur, responsables de l’assurance qualité et chefs de produit pour identifier, résoudre, concevoir et développer des correctifs et des améliorations du produit

 Développer du code de haute qualité, rédiger des tests fonctionnels et collaborer à la conception technique

 Faire partie d’une équipe conviviale, collaborative et hautement performante, et contribuer directement au succès de l’équipe Autodesk Consulting M&E et de nos clients

 Des déplacements occasionnels sur les sites des clients et dans les bureaux d’Autodesk peuvent être nécessaires

 
 Qualifications Minimales 
 Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en génie logiciel et/ou en production, idéalement dans le développement d’outils et de workflows à l’aide des API Maya C++ ou Python, en utilisant des algorithmes et des techniques d’infographie

 Connaissance avérée des pipelines de production de jeux vidéo et/ou de films

 Expérience et solide maîtrise du codage en C++ et Python.

 Solides compétences interpersonnelles et en résolution de problèmes, capacité à bien travailler au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire et performante, et à communiquer des informations hautement techniques aux clients

 Solides compétences en dépannage technique

 Excellentes compétences organisationnelles. A l’aise pour travailler de manière autonome afin de relever des défis dans un environnement de travail à distance.

 Expérience avec les frameworks d’IA/ML ainsi qu’avec l’utilisation de Codex ou d’autres outils similaires pour faciliter le codage.

 Maîtrise de l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit.

 
 Qualifications Souhaitées 
 Expérience dans l’utilisation ou le développement au sein d’autres produits clés d’Autodesk. Par exemple : Arnold, 3ds Max, MotionBuilder, Flow Production Tracking, Flow Capture, RV, etc.

 Connaissance de C# ou des moteurs de jeux (Unreal ou Unity)

 
 
 
 Learn More 







 
 About Autodesk 
 Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. 
 
 We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. 
 
 When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! 
 
 Salary transparency 







Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $139,000 and $249,260. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. 
 
Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $131,000 and $191,400. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. 
 Sales Careers 
 Working in sales at Autodesk allows you to build meaningful relationships with customers while growing your career. Join us and help make a better, more sustainable world. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/careers/sales 
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Autodesk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. We also consider for employment all qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.

 Belonging 
 We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging 

 In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification 
 This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.
